gloss: always; habitually; on a daily basis

definitions.gloss: always; habitually; on a daily basis; at all times
definitions.explanation: Describes something done regularly as a matter of course, or a habitual state of affairs. Somewhat formal.

examples.japanese: {常日頃|つねひごろ}⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧こと。
{常日頃|つねひごろ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}えている→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
examples.english: I train my body on a regular basis.

examples.japanese: {常日頃|つねひごろ}⟦{感|かん}じていた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ようやく⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I finally told my boss about the dissatisfaction I had always felt.

notes:
Means "always, habitually, on a regular basis." Emphasizes that something is a constant, ongoing state or habit. Somewhat formal in tone.

FORMS:
⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧ (always, constant) + ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧ (usually, daily life). More emphatic than ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧ alone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {常日頃|つねひごろ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from one's usual daily life, always
- {常日頃|つねひごろ}⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧: something one always thinks
- {常日頃|つねひごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧: one's usual conduct

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧: usually, normally (less emphatic)
- ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧: ordinarily, normally (casual)
- ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: always, constantly (more literary)
